prompt: Nikos is cooking, and his son is reaching towards the hot pan. Nikos does not want the boy to touch it.

Nikos would rather his son kept his hand away from the pan.
Nikos would rather his son keeps his hand away from the pan.

prompt: The warehouse alarm has gone off again, and the back door was open again. Aditya, who works near that door, still forgets to shut it after his breaks.
explanation_ru: После it's high time нужен Past Simple — remembered; remembers/to remember/would remember — ошибки.
options: It's high time Aditya remembers to shut the back door.
It's high time Aditya to remember to shut the back door.
It's high time Aditya remembered to shut the back door.
It's high time Aditya would remember to shut the back door.
answer: It's high time Aditya remembered to shut the back door.

prompt: Max's colleague talks as if she did not care about her daughter's concert.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: as if she did not care описывает нереальную ситуацию: на самом деле ей не всё равно, she cares about her daughter's concert.
options: She does not care about her daughter's concert.
She cares about her daughter's concert.
She cared about her daughter's concert in the past, not now.
She never cares about concerts.
answer: She cares about her daughter's concert.

prompt: It's high time the passengers removed the liquids from their bags.

explanation_ru: It's high time + Past Simple означает, что действие ещё не сделано: пассажиры пока не вынули жидкости.
options: The passengers have taken the liquids out.
The passengers took the liquids out before they arrived.
The passengers have not taken the liquids out.
The passengers will take the liquids out later.
answer: The passengers have not taken the liquids out.

prompt: At the ferry port, drivers are talking. Who does each action: the same person or a different person?
explanation_ru: would rather + инфинитив — действует тот же человек; would rather + подлежащее + Past Simple — действует другой человек.
sort_items: I'd rather wait in the car.
I'd rather you waited in the car.
We'd rather stay near the port.
I'd rather the driver moved the van.
She'd rather not drive in the dark.
They'd rather we joined the line.
I'd rather not sit in the sun.
answer_text: I'd rather wait in the car. → Same person · I'd rather you waited in the car. → Different person · We'd rather stay near the port. → Same person · I'd rather the driver moved the van. → Different person · She'd rather not drive in the dark. → Same person · They'd rather we joined the line. → Different person · I'd rather not sit in the sun. → Same person

prompt: Sort each sentence from Declan's warehouse: real world or inside-out world?
explanation_ru: Формы настоящего времени и can описывают реальные правила и планы (Real world), а Past Simple, would и wish — воображаемые или нереальные ситуации (Inside-out world).
sort_items: If new staff pass the trial, they get a full contract.
When Declan arrives early, he checks the boxes first.
If I worked in Augsburg, I would walk to the warehouse.
If we finish packing soon, we can go home.
If Declan had a van, he would not take the bus.
I wish the three-month trial were shorter.
answer_text: If new staff pass the trial, they get a full contract. → Real world · When Declan arrives early, he checks the boxes first. → Real world · If I worked in Augsburg, I would walk to the warehouse. → Inside-out world · If we finish packing soon, we can go home. → Real world · If Declan had a van, he would not take the bus. → Inside-out world · I wish the three-month trial were shorter. → Inside-out world

prompt: Marko runs a small shop in Nottingham. He keeps a receipt for each sale as a rule.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о постоянном правиле в магазине, поэтому нужен нулевой тип (Present Simple в обеих частях) и союз when. После if и when нельзя ставить will.
options: If a customer will buy something, Marko keeps the receipt.
When a customer buys something, Marko keeps the receipt.
If a customer bought something, Marko would keep the receipt.
When a customer buys something, Marko kept the receipt.
answer: When a customer buys something, Marko keeps the receipt.

prompt: At Kenta's lab in Delft, you cannot go inside if you ___ safety glasses.
explanation_ru: Это реальное правило безопасности, поэтому в придаточном после if используется Present Simple (do not wear). Ставить will или would сразу после if — частая ошибка.
options: will not wear
would not wear
do not wear
did not wear
answer: do not wear

prompt: Aleksandra says: "We will not play music if you (not / to finish) the safety checks."
explanation_ru: Это реальная договорённость на будущее (First Conditional), поэтому после if нужен Present Simple без will.
answer_text: Aleksandra says: "We will not play music if you do not finish the safety checks."

prompt: Astrid lives on a quiet farm. Her dog runs to the front gate each time the post van arrives.
explanation_ru: Действие повторяется регулярно и предсказуемо, поэтому выбираем Zero Conditional с when и Present Simple в обеих частях.
options: If the post van arrived, Astrid's dog would wait by the gate.
When the post van will turn the corner, Astrid's dog waits by the gate.
When the post van turns the corner, Astrid's dog waits by the gate.
If the post van turned the corner, Astrid's dog waited by the gate.
answer: When the post van turns the corner, Astrid's dog waits by the gate.

prompt: Bartek smiles: "I will dance if you ___ choose the first song."
explanation_ru: Бартек заключает реальное условие на ближайшее будущее (First Conditional), поэтому после if ставим Present Simple (let me), а не will или would.
options: to let me
let me
would let me
had let me
answer: let me

prompt: If the puppy will stop digging, Mehdi will buy it a new toy.
instruction_ru: Исправьте ошибку. Верное предложение перепишите без изменений.
explanation_ru: В реальном условии будущего (First Conditional) после if используется Present Simple (stops), а will остаётся только в главной части.
answer: If the puppy stops digging, Mehdi will buy it a new toy.
accepted_answers: If the puppy stops digging, Mehdi will buy it a new toy.

prompt: Decide whether each sentence about Isha's cat is a habit or a possible future event.
explanation_ru: Постоянные привычки кота передаются через Present Simple в обеих частях (Zero Conditional), а конкретные возможные события в будущем — через will (First Conditional).
sort_items: When the morning sun hits the rug, Isha's cat sits there.
If the sun comes out later, the cat will sleep on the rug.
Isha's cat hides under the bed when loud trucks pass the house.
If Isha opens a can of fish, the cat runs to the kitchen.
If it stays cloudy this afternoon, Isha will move the rug inside.
Will the cat wake up if we close the door quietly?
answer_text: When the morning sun hits the rug, Isha's cat sits there. → Always true (habit) · If the sun comes out later, the cat will sleep on the rug. → Possible future · Isha's cat hides under the bed when loud trucks pass the house. → Always true (habit) · If Isha opens a can of fish, the cat runs to the kitchen. → Always true (habit) · If it stays cloudy this afternoon, Isha will move the rug inside. → Possible future · Will the cat wake up if we close the door quietly? → Possible future

prompt: A note from Roisin's seaside café in Split.
instruction_ru: Нажмите на все предложения с ошибкой.
explanation_ru: В предложении 2 стоит will после if — это типичная ошибка: для правила и реального условия после if нужен Present Simple (ask).
sentences: Welcome to Roisin's seaside café in Split.
If your fish takes over twenty minutes, you get a free drink.
If you will ask for cold water, we bring it straight away.
We also close the garden when the sea wind gets too strong.

fixes.2: If you ask for cold water, we bring it straight away.

answer_text: Sentence 3: If you ask for cold water, we bring it straight away.

prompt: A door guard stops us at a club in Nanchang. "If guests {{1:to bring}} drinks from outside, I never let them in," he says. "Wait — if we put our cups in the bin, it {{2:to be}} fine, won't it?" I ask. My friend sighs, "If I {{3:to have}} a bigger bag, I would not lose my tea."
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске общее правило клуба (Zero: bring), во втором — конкретная договорённость в будущем с хвостиком won't it (First: will be), в третьем — нереальная ситуация сейчас (Second: had).
answer_text: A door guard stops us at a club in Nanchang. "If guests bring drinks from outside, I never let them in," he says. "Wait — if we put our cups in the bin, it will be fine, won't it?" I ask. My friend sighs, "If I had a bigger bag, I would not lose my tea."

prompt: Group these sentences from Ayse's office in Adana by their real meaning.
explanation_ru: Реальные правила и планы строятся в настоящем и с will, нереальное настоящее — через Past Simple / would / wish, а нереальное прошлое — через Past Perfect и would have + V3.
sort_items: When a team starts a meeting at Ayse's office, someone prints an agenda.
If Ayse finishes the report before lunch, she will email the new agenda.
If our manager did not love paper, we would read the agenda on our screens.
I wish we had a faster printer on the third floor.
If Ayse had printed ten copies, everyone would have had a sheet.
We would not have wasted twenty minutes if the agenda had been clear.
answer_text: When a team starts a meeting at Ayse's office, someone prints an agenda. → Real rule or plan · If Ayse finishes the report before lunch, she will email the new agenda. → Real rule or plan · If our manager did not love paper, we would read the agenda on our screens. → Unreal now · I wish we had a faster printer on the third floor. → Unreal now · If Ayse had printed ten copies, everyone would have had a sheet. → Unreal past · We would not have wasted twenty minutes if the agenda had been clear. → Unreal past

prompt: A notice in the cinema lobby in Datong says the late Sunday film is cancelled. You did not read it, so you went there for nothing.
explanation_ru: Событие уже произошло в прошлом и его нельзя изменить, поэтому нужен Third Conditional (had read … would not have gone). После if нельзя использовать would have.
options: If I would have read the notice, I would not have gone to the cinema.
If I read the notice, I would not go to the cinema.
If I had read the notice, I would not have gone to the cinema.
If I had read the notice, I will not go to the cinema.
answer: If I had read the notice, I would not have gone to the cinema.

prompt: If we had brought folding chairs to the film club trip in Taiyuan, we would not have stood during the whole film.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Third Conditional описывает нереальное прошлое и меняет знак обеих частей: на самом деле стулья не взяли (did not bring) и простояли весь фильм (stood).
options: We brought folding chairs and stood during the whole film.
We did not bring folding chairs and we stood during the whole film.
We do not bring folding chairs and we stand during all films.
We did not bring folding chairs, so we found free seats.
answer: We did not bring folding chairs and we stood during the whole film.

prompt: Lucy works as a guard at an art garden in Brașov. A big school group arrived at the gate, and she warned the teachers, "If the children {{1:to stay}} with you, the visit {{2:to go}} smoothly." Ten minutes later, two boys climbed a stone wall, so Lucy ended the tour. "If you {{3:to watch}} them properly, we {{4:not / to stop}} the visit," she said.
explanation_ru: Перед началом экскурсии Люси говорит о реальном будущем (First Conditional: stay … will go), а после её отмены сожалеет о прошлом, которое уже не исправить (Third Conditional: had watched … would not have stopped).
answer_text: Lucy works as a guard at an art garden in Brașov. A big school group arrived at the gate, and she warned the teachers, "If the children stay with you, the visit will go smoothly." Ten minutes later, two boys climbed a stone wall, so Lucy ended the tour. "If you had watched them properly, we would not have stopped the visit," she said.

prompt: Mason's class in Ostrava forgot their safety glasses, so they could not do the chemistry test. Mason said, "If you ___ your glasses, we would have started the experiment on time."
explanation_ru: Класс уже забыл очки в прошлом, поэтому для условия нужен Past Perfect (had brought). Ошибки — ставить Past Simple (как во 2-м типе) или would have сразу после if.
options: had brought
brought
would have brought
will bring
answer: had brought

prompt: I missed the pharmacy notice in Brest. If I (to check) the hours online, I (to collect) my medicine earlier.
explanation_ru: Оба факта относятся к уже завершённому прошлому (объявление пропустили, лекарство не забрали), поэтому выбираем Third Conditional: had checked … would have collected.
answer_text: I missed the pharmacy notice in Brest. If I had checked the hours online, I would have collected my medicine earlier.

prompt: If I would live closer to the clinic in Gomel, I would not miss my morning blood test.
instruction_ru: Исправьте ошибку. Верное предложение перепишите без изменений.
explanation_ru: Русское «если бы» часто провоцирует ошибку if + would, но в Second Conditional после if нужен Past Simple (lived), а would стоит только в главной части.
answer: If I lived closer to the clinic in Gomel, I would not miss my morning blood test.
accepted_answers: If I lived closer to the clinic in Gomel, I would not miss my morning blood test.
If I lived closer to the clinic in Gomel, I wouldn't miss my morning blood test.

prompt: The oldest computer at our internet café in Keelung has a known bug: two print jobs at the same time freeze the screen. You are warning a new customer about this regular problem.
explanation_ru: Это реальная повторяющаяся закономерность, поэтому используется Zero Conditional (when + Present Simple, Present Simple), а не нереальные 2-й и 3-й типы и не will после when.
options: If two people printed at once, this old computer would freeze.
When two people print at once, this old computer freezes.
When two people will print at once, this old computer freezes.
If two people had printed at once, this old computer would have frozen.
answer: When two people print at once, this old computer freezes.

prompt: I would pay my bills after work if the bank in Kragujevac did not close early on Fridays for training.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Second Conditional показывает нереальную ситуацию в настоящем: на деле банк закрывается рано по пятницам, поэтому счета после работы не оплачиваются.
options: The bank closes early on Fridays, so I do not pay my bills after work.
The bank closed early on Friday, so I did not pay my bills.
The bank does not close early on Fridays, so I pay my bills after work.
The bank closes early on Fridays, but I still pay my bills after work.
answer: The bank closes early on Fridays, so I do not pay my bills after work.

prompt: Classify each sentence from Jing's tour of the old fort in Muscat.
explanation_ru: When употребляется для неизбежных регулярных событий, if + Present Simple — для возможных условий, а if + Past Simple / Past Perfect — для нереальных ситуаций.
sort_items: When the afternoon sun drops behind the fort, the stone walls turn orange.
When Jing opens the tower door, visitors climb the narrow stairs.
If you leave your backpack at the desk, you may enter the tower.
If the wind gets stronger, Jing will close the roof for safety.
If the stairs were wider, large tour groups would move much faster.
If we had left our bags downstairs, we would not have dropped the camera.
answer_text: When the afternoon sun drops behind the fort, the stone walls turn orange. → Certain (when) · When Jing opens the tower door, visitors climb the narrow stairs. → Certain (when) · If you leave your backpack at the desk, you may enter the tower. → Possible (if) · If the wind gets stronger, Jing will close the roof for safety. → Possible (if) · If the stairs were wider, large tour groups would move much faster. → Unreal (if) · If we had left our bags downstairs, we would not have dropped the camera. → Unreal (if)

prompt: An email from the spring fair organiser in Montevideo.
instruction_ru: Нажмите на все предложения с ошибкой.
explanation_ru: В предложении 1 лишнее will после if (нужен Present Simple: comes), а в предложении 3 ошибка if + would вместо Past Simple (were/was) в Second Conditional.
sentences: Because of the heavy rain, we have moved the spring fair indoors to the community centre.
If the sun will come out later, we will open the garden stalls as well.
All visitors get a dry seat when they arrive at the main hall.
If the hall would be larger, we would add ten more food stalls.
Please bring a light coat in case the hallway feels cold.

fixes.1: If the sun comes out later, we will open the garden stalls as well.
fixes.3: If the hall were larger, we would add ten more food stalls.

answer_text: Sentence 2: If the sun comes out later, we will open the garden stalls as well. · Sentence 4: If the hall were larger, we would add ten more food stalls.

prompt: Baptiste loves the street parties near the beach in Zanzibar. Whenever the neighbours {{1:to plan}} a dinner, everyone brings extra plates, so nobody goes home hungry. Tomorrow evening we are cooking fish on the sand, and if the rain {{2:to stay}} away, we {{3:to eat}} under the stars. My cousin cannot come because he is working, and he says, "I wish I {{4:to be}} there with you."
explanation_ru: Привычка соседей передаётся через Zero Conditional (plan), реальный план на завтра — через First Conditional (stays … will eat), а сожаление о настоящем — через wish + Past Simple (were/was).
answer_text: Baptiste loves the street parties near the beach in Zanzibar. Whenever the neighbours plan a dinner, everyone brings extra plates, so nobody goes home hungry. Tomorrow evening we are cooking fish on the sand, and if the rain stays away, we will eat under the stars. My cousin cannot come because he is working, and he says, "I wish I were there with you."

prompt: A junior technician in Taoyuan restarted the main server last night without backing up the files first, so the whole office is trying to recover lost data right now.
explanation_ru: Условие относится к прошлому (не сделал резервную копию — Past Perfect: had backed up), а результат виден прямо сейчас (would not be recovering) — это смешанный тип (Mixed Conditional).
options: If the technician had backed up the files, the office would not be recovering lost data now.
If the technician backed up the files, the office would not be recovering lost data now.
If the technician had backed up the files, the office would not have recovered lost data.
If the technician would have backed up the files, the office would not be recovering lost data now.
answer: If the technician had backed up the files, the office would not be recovering lost data now.

prompt: Had the passengers in Novi Pazar stepped away from the metro doors when the guard warned them, they would not be waiting for a night bus in the rain.
instruction_ru: Выберите, что произошло на самом деле.
explanation_ru: Инверсия Had … stepped показывает нереальное прошлое (они не отошли от дверей), а would not be waiting — нереальное настоящее (они действительно ждут автобус прямо сейчас).
options: The passengers stepped away from the doors, so they caught the last metro train.
The passengers did not step away from the doors, so they took a night bus home.
The passengers did not step away from the doors, so they are stuck waiting for a night bus.
The passengers do not step away from the doors, so they miss the last train.
answer: The passengers did not step away from the doors, so they are stuck waiting for a night bus.

prompt: Jovan refused to start the riverside clean-up in Vientiane because the council never sent gloves or rubbish bags, and the volunteers are still sitting on the grass. "We would not be sitting here doing nothing if the council ___ the gloves and bags," he mutters.
explanation_ru: Настоящий результат (would not be sitting) вызван нереальным условием в прошлом (совет не прислал инвентарь), поэтому после if нужен Past Perfect (had sent), а не Past Simple или would.
options: sent
would send
will send
had sent
answer: had sent

prompt: Saeed plays guitar near the main fountain in Skopje and knows everyone's habits. Whenever the square clock strikes twelve, the same old man {{1:to throw}} bread to the birds while Saeed plays a quiet tune. Today, however, the bench is empty and the birds look confused. "If he {{2:to come}} by this afternoon, I {{3:to ask}} if he is feeling well," Saeed thinks. "Still, if I {{4:to learn}} his name last summer, I would know who to ask about him today."
explanation_ru: Привычное действие старика требует Zero Conditional (throws), возможная встреча днём — First Conditional (comes … will ask), а связь прошлого условия с настоящим (would know today) — Mixed Conditional (had learnt).
answer_text: Saeed plays guitar near the main fountain in Skopje and knows everyone's habits. Whenever the square clock strikes twelve, the same old man throws bread to the birds while Saeed plays a quiet tune. Today, however, the bench is empty and the birds look confused. "If he comes by this afternoon, I will ask if he is feeling well," Saeed thinks. "Still, if I had learnt his name last summer, I would know who to ask about him today."

prompt: Match each sentence about campfires in Windhoek National Park to its exact conditional logic.
explanation_ru: В смешанных предложениях (Mixed time shift) две части относятся к разным временам: прошлое условие даёт результат в настоящем или постоянная черта в настоящем объясняет ошибку в прошлом.
sort_items: When campers light a fire inside the marked stone circles, the dry grass around the campsite stays safe.
If the wind picks up after sunset, the park rangers will ask all groups to put out their flames.
If visitors did not ignore the wooden signs, rangers would spend far less time checking the trails.
Had the group followed the park notice, the wooden bench would not have caught fire during the storm.
If those hikers had used the stone circle, the park office would not be repairing the fence this week.
If the campers were more careful by nature, they would not have left hot ashes near the bushes.
answer_text: When campers light a fire inside the marked stone circles, the dry grass around the campsite stays safe. → General rule or real future · If the wind picks up after sunset, the park rangers will ask all groups to put out their flames. → General rule or real future · If visitors did not ignore the wooden signs, rangers would spend far less time checking the trails. → Unreal present or past · Had the group followed the park notice, the wooden bench would not have caught fire during the storm. → Unreal present or past · If those hikers had used the stone circle, the park office would not be repairing the fence this week. → Mixed time shift · If the campers were more careful by nature, they would not have left hot ashes near the bushes. → Mixed time shift

prompt: Neda's camp notes from a windy evening in Patagonia.
instruction_ru: Нажмите на все предложения с ошибкой.
explanation_ru: В предложении 1 ошибка — will после only if в реальном условии (нужно drops), а в предложении 3 ошибка — would have после if вместо Past Perfect (had checked) в Third Conditional.
sentences: The mountain wind in Patagonia is fierce tonight, so we have not lit the campfire yet.

When the gusts die down on calm nights, the whole valley turns completely silent.

fixes.1: I have promised the hikers that we will light the fire only if the wind drops below the safe limit.
fixes.3: If we had checked the weather report before leaving town, we would have brought warmer coats.

answer_text: Sentence 2: I have promised the hikers that we will light the fire only if the wind drops below the safe limit. · Sentence 4: If we had checked the weather report before leaving town, we would have brought warmer coats.

prompt: Aya leads walking tours in the Lake District, and she knows the lakeside path closes whenever heavy rain floods the bridge. Because it poured all morning, the path is shut and her group had to take the steep hill track instead.
explanation_ru: Утренний ливень и выбор другого маршрута уже в прошлом, поэтому нужен Third Conditional (if + Past Perfect, would have + V3). Союз when и формы 1-го и 2-го типов сюда не подходят.
options: If the rain held off this morning, Aya's group would walk along the lakeside path.
If the rain will hold off this morning, Aya's group will walk along the lakeside path.
When the rain had held off this morning, Aya's group would have walked along the lakeside path.
If the rain had held off this morning, Aya's group would have walked along the lakeside path.
answer: If the rain had held off this morning, Aya's group would have walked along the lakeside path.

prompt: A travel writer's diary from Ketut's riverboat in Borneo.
instruction_ru: Нажмите на все предложения с ошибкой.
explanation_ru: В предложении 3 допущена типичная ошибка «если бы → if + would»: в условной части Second Conditional нужен Past Simple (left), а would остаётся только в главной части.
sentences: Ketut has steered wooden boats along this river in Borneo for thirty years.
During the dry season, the thick morning mist clears from the water by ten o'clock whenever the sun warms the trees.
Yesterday, however, a freak storm rolled in, and I asked Ketut what would happen if we left the bank too early.
He laughed and said, "If we would leave in heavy fog, we would miss the narrow channel completely."
We waited over sweet tea instead, and the whole trip went smoothly once the sky opened.

fixes.3: He laughed and said, "If we left in heavy fog, we would miss the narrow channel completely."

answer_text: Sentence 4: He laughed and said, "If we left in heavy fog, we would miss the narrow channel completely."

prompt: I play in a small band at a jazz café in Okayama, and the owner follows a lovely routine. Whenever nine o'clock comes round, he {{1:to turn}} down the lights right before our first slow song. Last Friday, however, the wall switch broke during the set, and he still has not called an electrician, so we are rehearsing in half-darkness tonight. "If I {{2:to fix}} that switch earlier, the room {{3:not / to look}} like a dark cave right now," he groaned, adding, "What {{4:you / to do}} if the power goes out mid-song tonight?"
explanation_ru: Регулярная привычка хозяина выражена через Zero Conditional (turns), связь прошлой ошибки с тем, как зал выглядит сейчас — через Mixed Conditional (had fixed … would not look), а вопрос о реальном риске сегодня вечером — через First Conditional (will you do).
answer_text: I play in a small band at a jazz café in Okayama, and the owner follows a lovely routine. Whenever nine o'clock comes round, he turns down the lights right before our first slow song. Last Friday, however, the wall switch broke during the set, and he still has not called an electrician, so we are rehearsing in half-darkness tonight. "If I had fixed that switch earlier, the room would not look like a dark cave right now," he groaned, adding, "What will you do if the power goes out mid-song tonight?"

prompt: Sort these sentences about our old cat in Tartu: Reality or Inside-out?
explanation_ru: Предложения группы Reality описывают реальные привычки и возможные планы (Present Simple, will). Группа Inside-out — воображаемые ситуации и желания (Past Simple после if и wish, would).
sort_items: When the bell rings, the cat hides under the sofa.
If a visitor comes in, she will stay under there.
When we open a can of fish, she runs straight into the kitchen.
If she were braver, she would greet our guests.
I wish she liked meeting new people.
If we lived on a quiet farm, she would sit by the door.
answer_text: When the bell rings, the cat hides under the sofa. → Reality · If a visitor comes in, she will stay under there. → Reality · When we open a can of fish, she runs straight into the kitchen. → Reality · If she were braver, she would greet our guests. → Inside-out · I wish she liked meeting new people. → Inside-out · If we lived on a quiet farm, she would sit by the door. → Inside-out

prompt: Your rabbit will get ill if you ___ him too many sweet treats.
explanation_ru: Это реальное предупреждение о будущем (First Conditional). В части с if нужен Present Simple (give), а не will или would.
options: will give
give
gave
would give
answer: give

prompt: In a small pot, pasta always (to stick) together if you (not / to stir) it.
explanation_ru: Речь идёт о постоянном кулинарном факте (Zero Conditional), поэтому в обеих частях используется Present Simple: sticks и don't stir.
answer_text: In a small pot, pasta always sticks together if you don't stir it.

prompt: Bartek is looking at the messy playground in Derry. He wants to make a real deal with the children before the bell rings.
explanation_ru: Ситуация реальна и относится к ближайшему будущему, поэтому нужен First Conditional: Present Simple после if (tidy) и will в главной части (will read).
options: If you tidied the toy box, I would read you a story.
If you will tidy the toy box, I will read you a story.
If you tidy the toy box, I will read you a story.
If you had tidied the toy box, I would have read you a story.
answer: If you tidy the toy box, I will read you a story.

prompt: Mehdi can hold the last board game if you will call before six.
instruction_ru: Исправьте ошибку. Верное предложение перепишите без изменений.
explanation_ru: После союза if в реальном условии о будущем (First Conditional) нельзя ставить will — нужен Present Simple (if you call).
answer: Mehdi can hold the last board game if you call before six.

prompt: Put these sentences from the fruit market in Ghent into two groups: Real or Unreal.
explanation_ru: В группе Real — реальные привычки и возможные события (Present Simple, will). В группе Unreal — воображаемые условия и желания, которые не соответствуют действительности (Past Simple после if и wish, would).
sort_items: When light rain starts, the fruit workers cover their tables.
If the wind gets stronger, we will tie down the plastic sheet.
Unless it stops raining soon, fewer people will walk past.
If this square had a roof, our boxes would stay dry.
We wouldn't need big coats if the market were indoors.
I wish we had a dry indoor shop.
answer_text: When light rain starts, the fruit workers cover their tables. → Real · If the wind gets stronger, we will tie down the plastic sheet. → Real · Unless it stops raining soon, fewer people will walk past. → Real · If this square had a roof, our boxes would stay dry. → Unreal · We wouldn't need big coats if the market were indoors. → Unreal · I wish we had a dry indoor shop. → Unreal
